sequencing_rationale: Begin with model, numerical method, error and validation discipline before domain applications.
Apply mechanics and nonequilibrium/statistical ideas to biological systems with explicit domain boundaries.
Build medical-imaging and dose concepts on measurement and electromagnetic-wave foundations.
Introduce atmospheric applications through pressure, temperature and radiation before complex Earth-system specialization.
Use wave, gravity and magnetic measurements as physical probes before geoscience interpretation.
Build energy-system reasoning from conservation, entropy, efficiency and electrical power before broader lifecycle questions.
Conclude with sensors by integrating measurement, calibration, signals, circuits and uncertainty.
